tools.name: copilot.check_environment
tools.title: Check Copilot CLI Environment
tools.description: Verify that Copilot CLI is installed and authenticated on the MCP server machine, report supported CLI capabilities, and discover custom agents visible from an optional repository directory. Call this before the first run when environment readiness is unknown.

cwd.description: Optional existing directory on the MCP server machine used to discover the nearest project-level .github/agents folder. Absolute paths are recommended. Defaults to the server workspace root.

outputSchema.description: Environment readiness, installed CLI capabilities, and custom agents visible from cwd.

cli.description: Probe result and booleans for agent, session, attachment, reasoning, and cancellation capabilities. Host-side process termination is used when the CLI has no cancel command.

agents.description: Discovered agents with id, name, description, argument hint, scope, and source path.

tools.name: copilot.list_agents
tools.title: List Copilot Agents
tools.description: List custom Copilot agents visible from a repository: workspace and nearest project .github/agents plus the MCP server user's ~/.copilot/agents. Use the returned id as copilot.run_agent.agent.

cwd.description: Optional existing directory on the MCP server machine used to discover the nearest project-level .github/agents folder. Absolute paths are recommended. Defaults to the server workspace root.

outputSchema.description: Custom agents visible from the resolved repository directory.

agents.description: Agents with id, name, description, argument hint, scope, and source path.

tools.name: copilot.list_source_roots
tools.title: List Copilot Source Roots
tools.description: List configured extra source directory roots that the Copilot MCP handler searches for project .github/agents directories.

roots.description: Configured source roots with id, label, path, and enabled flag.

tools.name: copilot.upsert_source_root
tools.title: Add Or Update Copilot Source Root
tools.description: Add or update one extra source directory root used for Copilot agent discovery. The path must exist on the MCP server machine. If the path is a repository root, the nearest .github/agents directory under it is used; if the path itself is a .github/agents directory, it is used directly.

id.description: Stable root id. Optional; defaults to a normalized basename of the path.

path.description: Existing directory on the MCP server machine. Can be a repository root or a direct .github/agents directory.

enabled.description: Whether this root should participate in discovery. Defaults to true.

tools.name: copilot.remove_source_root
tools.title: Remove Copilot Source Root
tools.description: Remove one configured extra source directory root by id.

id.description: The configured source root id to remove.

tools.name: copilot.run_agent
tools.title: Run Copilot Agent
tools.description: Start a headless Copilot CLI task in an existing repository on the MCP server machine. Copilot tools are auto-approved, so the run may read or modify repository files and execute permitted commands. Omit agent for normal Copilot behavior, or select a discovered custom agent. Use runMode=sync for the final response, or runMode=async to receive a process-local run id and then poll copilot.get_run or cancel with copilot.cancel_run. Async records disappear when the MCP server restarts.

message.description: Prompt text to send to Copilot.

agent.description: Optional custom agent id (file stem without .agent.md). When omitted, Copilot chooses normally.

cwd.description: Optional existing repository directory on the MCP server machine, passed to Copilot with -C. Absolute paths are recommended. Defaults to the server workspace root.

addDirs.description: Optional existing directories on the MCP server machine passed with --add-dir. Absolute paths are recommended.

attachments.description: Optional existing files on the MCP server machine attached to the initial prompt. Absolute paths are recommended.

sessionId.description: Optional UUID that creates a new stable session or resumes the existing session with that UUID. Mutually exclusive with continueSession, resumeSession, and sessionName.

continueSession.description: Resume the most recent Copilot session before sending the prompt. Mutually exclusive with sessionId, resumeSession, and sessionName.

resumeSession.description: Resume by session id, id prefix, task id, or exact session name. Mutually exclusive with sessionId, continueSession, and sessionName. The interactive session picker is intentionally not exposed by this hosted tool.

sessionName.description: Optional name for a newly created session. Mutually exclusive with sessionId, continueSession, and resumeSession.

reasoningEffort.description: Optional native Copilot reasoning effort level.

additionalMcpConfigs.description: Optional MCP configuration JSON strings or @file paths passed to Copilot for this run.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum runtime in milliseconds for sync or async execution. Defaults to 300000 (5 minutes); async timeout produces status timed_out.

invocationMode.description: How to target the agent: flag (default, uses --agent) or prompt (injects an explicit instruction into the prompt).

runMode.description: sync waits for completion; async starts a background run and returns a run id for later polling/cancellation. Async runs and records are owned by this MCP server process and do not survive restart.

outputSchema.description: For sync mode, contains code, stdout, stderr, resolved invocation settings, and repository paths. For async mode, contains run with its run id and initial running status.

run.description: Async-mode process-local run record. Its id is required by get_run and cancel_run; initial status is running.

tools.name: copilot.list_runs
tools.title: List Copilot Runs
tools.description: List process-local async Copilot runs started through this MCP server. Records include running, completed, failed, cancelled, and timed_out states, retain accumulated output, and disappear when the MCP server restarts.

outputSchema.description: Current process-local async run records, newest first.

runs.description: Run records containing id, status, timestamps, resolved invocation settings, stdout, stderr, exit code, error, cancellation/timeout flags, and pid.

tools.name: copilot.get_run
tools.title: Get Copilot Run
tools.description: Poll one process-local async Copilot run by id. Status is running, completed, failed, cancelled, or timed_out; stdout and stderr accumulate while running. The id becomes unknown after MCP server restart or completed-record trimming.

runId.description: The run id returned by copilot.run_agent in async mode.

outputSchema.description: The complete run record and a concise preview of its current output.

run.description: Run record containing id; status (running, completed, failed, cancelled, or timed_out); timestamps; invocation settings; stdout; stderr; exit code; error; cancellation/timeout flags; and pid.

outputPreview.description: Current stdout, otherwise stderr, or a no-output placeholder.

tools.name: copilot.cancel_run
tools.title: Cancel Copilot Run
tools.description: Request cancellation of a process-local async Copilot run by id. On Windows the server terminates the full process tree; elsewhere it sends SIGTERM. Poll copilot.get_run afterward to observe the final cancelled state. Completed runs are returned unchanged.

runId.description: The run id returned by copilot.run_agent in async mode.

outputSchema.description: The run record after cancellation was requested, or the unchanged record when it had already finished.

run.description: Run record containing id, status, timestamps, output, exit/error details, cancellation/timeout flags, and pid.
